canonical_task_lifecycle_exact_argv.claim_parsing_rule: Strictly decode JSON result from task claim; verify state == 'executing' and extract integer attempt (e.g. 1). Fail closed on any missing field, Error response, or unexpected status; never fall back or default to 1.

coordinator_session_and_lease_lifecycle.register: session_authority.run(['register', session_id, 'telegram_bridge', ...]) creates session in coordinator store.
coordinator_session_and_lease_lifecycle.singleton_claim: session_authority.run(['claim', session_id, 'runtime:telegram-bridge', '1', '30', op_id]) acquires singleton bridge lock.
coordinator_session_and_lease_lifecycle.renew_rule: Heartbeat alone updates session timestamp and does NOT renew resource leases. Leases must be explicitly renewed: session_authority.run(['renew', session_id, 'runtime:telegram-bridge', '1', '30', op_id <> '-renew']).
coordinator_session_and_lease_lifecycle.stop_and_retire: On clean shutdown, session_authority.run(['release', session_id, 'runtime:telegram-bridge', '1', op_id]) followed by session_authority.run(['retire', session_id, op_id]).

per_request_risk_authority_reconciliatio.policy_binding: Preflight check verifies service policy rules and toolchain integrity under SC-RISK-CHECK-001. The per-request task created in uos/telegram-service/boot reconciles against this service policy with truthful observed evidence and zero fabricated risk ratings.

outbound_send_verification_and_uncertain.botapi_validation: BotAPI response to sendMessage must satisfy: (1) HTTP status == 200, (2) JSON top-level 'ok' == true, (3) response 'result'.'message_id' > 0, (4) response 'result'.'chat'.'id' == target chat_id. Any violation (including malformed HTTP 200) transitions outbox row to UNCERTAIN.
outbound_send_verification_and_uncertain.no_blind_retry: Blind retries over Telegram BotAPI are strictly prohibited. Operator manual retry uses the existing request_id with incremented attempt_count.

retention_and_durability.wal_full_sync: PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; PRAGMA synchronous = FULL; ensures write-ahead log frames are synced to non-volatile disk on commit, subject to underlying drive write-cache honoring flush.
retention_and_durability.retention_policy: NO automatic deletion initially. PENDING, PROCESSING, and UNCERTAIN rows are never pruned to prevent replay. Only terminal rows (COMPLETED, DELIVERED, REJECTED) older than 30 days are candidates for scheduled offline archival.

directive_honesty.checklist: The 18/18 checklist represents structural requirements; unverified runtime items are reported as UNOBSERVED_RUNTIME or UNRUN. Fabricated green counts are strictly barred.
directive_honesty.doctor_ev: EV ceiling is strictly EV-93; cycles EV-94..EV-109 are explicitly stated as NOT_ADMITTED.

cutover_and_initial_rollback.quiesce_order: Quiesce and stop legacy tools/telegram_client.ml poller process BEFORE launching new Gleam service. Verify PID is gone and watermark offset is frozen.
cutover_and_initial_rollback.initial_rollback_rule: Because NO prior immutable Telegram release exists, initial rollback must STOP the new service and PRESERVE all queued inbox/outbox/watermark entries. It must NEVER blindly re-enable the unsafe legacy poller or revert to imaginary releases.
